title: Flow Matching under Noisy Latent Structure: Beyond Exact Low-Dimensional Support
abstract: arXiv:2609.38918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) learns a velocity field whose ODE transports a simple source distribution to a target law. Existing finite-sample theory largely treats ambient-space regularity or data supported exactly on low-dimensional sets. We study linear FM under a noisy latent-generator model, where a low-dimensional H\"older map is perturbed by nondegenerate ambient Gaussian noise, so the target law is full-dimensional despite its latent structure. We construct a spatially regular ReLU velocity class and establish non-asymptotic high-probability approximation and estimation bounds whose leading sample-size exponent is governed by the latent dimension rather than the ambient dimension, with ambient and noise dependence kept explicit. Fixed positive target noise keeps the interpolation nondegenerate over the full time interval. tldr: 论文研究了噪声潜在生成模型下的流匹配，证明了其样本复杂度指数由潜在维度而非环境维度决定，突破了传统理论要求精确低维支撑的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper studies Flow Matching under a noisy latent-generator model, showing that the leading sample-size exponent depends on the latent dimension rather than the ambient dimension, thereby going beyond existing theories that require exact low-dimensional support.
